title: Short Answer Questions | IoT (Unit Wise)
heading: Short Answer Practice - IoT (All Units)
description: 30 short answer questions covering Unit 1 to Unit 5 of IoT. Perfect for quick revision and exam preparation.

questions.question: Name any one short-range communication technology used in IoT.
questions.sampleAnswer: Bluetooth / Zigbee / NFC / BLE

questions.question: Expand IPv6.
questions.sampleAnswer: Internet Protocol Version 6

questions.question: What is IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: IoT is a network of interconnected physical devices that collect and exchange data over the internet.

questions.question: What is M2M communication?
questions.sampleAnswer: Machine-to-Machine communication refers to direct communication between devices without human intervention.

questions.question: What is XaaS in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: Everything as a Service model where computing resources are delivered over the internet.

questions.question: What is IoT analytics used for?
questions.sampleAnswer: To analyze sensor data and extract meaningful insights for decision-making.

questions.question: What are the main views in IoT reference architecture?
questions.sampleAnswer: Functional, Information, Deployment, Operational views

questions.question: What is Functional View in IoT architecture?
questions.sampleAnswer: It defines system functions and their relationships.

questions.question: What is Deployment View?
questions.sampleAnswer: It describes physical distribution of IoT components.

questions.question: What is Operational View?
questions.sampleAnswer: It describes runtime behavior of IoT systems.

questions.question: What is Data Visualization in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: Representation of data in graphical form for analysis.

questions.question: What is a Reference Model in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: A conceptual framework defining structure and behavior of IoT systems.

questions.question: What is 6LoWPAN?
questions.sampleAnswer: IPv6 over Low Power Wireless Personal Area Networks.

questions.question: What is Zigbee used for?
questions.sampleAnswer: Low-power short-range wireless communication.

questions.question: What is IPv6?
questions.sampleAnswer: A 128-bit Internet Protocol version used for large address space.

questions.question: What is BLE?
questions.sampleAnswer: Bluetooth Low Energy used for low-power wireless communication.

questions.question: What is RPL?
questions.sampleAnswer: Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks.

questions.question: What is MAC layer?
questions.sampleAnswer: Layer responsible for controlling access to the communication medium.

questions.question: Which protocol is used for lightweight publish-subscribe messaging in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: MQTT

questions.question: What is the purpose of CoAP protocol?
questions.sampleAnswer: To enable communication for constrained IoT devices.

questions.question: What is TCP?
questions.sampleAnswer: A reliable, connection-oriented transport protocol.

questions.question: What is UDP?
questions.sampleAnswer: A lightweight, connectionless transport protocol.

questions.question: What is TLS?
questions.sampleAnswer: Transport Layer Security used for encryption and secure communication.

questions.question: What is DTLS?
questions.sampleAnswer: Datagram TLS used to secure UDP communication.

questions.question: What is 6LoWPAN?
questions.sampleAnswer: Adaptation layer enabling IPv6 over low-power networks.

questions.question: What is the purpose of data analytics in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: To extract insights and support decision-making.

questions.question: What is oneM2M?
questions.sampleAnswer: A global standard for IoT service layer interoperability.

questions.question: What is ETSI M2M?
questions.sampleAnswer: A standard for machine-to-machine communication architecture.

questions.question: What is MAC security in IEEE 802.15.4?
questions.sampleAnswer: It ensures confidentiality and integrity of data at link layer.

questions.question: What is the application layer in IoT?
questions.sampleAnswer: The layer that provides services and interfaces to end users.
